title: What You Have and Haven't Done

sections.content: Use ya + pretérito *perfecto* for completed experiences and *todavía* no + pretérito perfecto for experiences that have not happened yet. The two forms create a useful contrast.

items.english: We have already visited the market.

items.spanish: Todavía no hemos hablado con los vendedores.
items.english: We have not spoken with the sellers yet.
I have already tried the fruit.

sections.content: Keep the auxiliary and participle together. Use ya for completed actions and *todavía* no for actions that have not happened yet.
